comment: Suites that fail IDENTICALLY at the baseline and are not caused by recent work (CLAUDE.md, the 2026-11-19 manual runs). The gate calls a failure KNOWN only when it matches: the exit code (if given), the text in expect.contains (if given), at most expect.fail failures, and EVERY failing line contains one of expect.names. A new, different or more numerous failure is a REGRESSION: a known failure cannot hide a new one. When a known failure is fixed the gate prints FIXED: delete its entry in the same commit. When the owner accepts a new failure, add it here in the commit that records the acceptance.
